name: assistant-storefront
description: A small, production-shaped storefront (React + Vite, Express + TypeScript, Postgres via Supabase) that AI assistants can drive through an MCP server.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @storefront/api" "npm run dev -w @storefront/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @storefront/shared && npm run build -w @storefront/api && npm run build -w @storefront/web && npm run build -w @storefront/mcp
